CustomField.formula: IF(AND(Trust__r.Enrollment_Date__c < DATE(2023,10,1), TMHP_Amount_Owed__c > (Balance_After_Fees__c - Balance_After_Fees_to_Arcare__c)), 0, IF(AND(Trust__r.Enrollment_Date__c >= DATE(2023,10,1), TMHP_Amount_Owed__c > (Balance_After_Fees__c - Balance_After_Fees_to_Arcare__c)), Balance_After_Fees__c - Balance_After_Fees_to_Arcare__c, 0))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For Trusts with Enrollment Dates on or after 10/1/2023, where the TMHP Amount Owed is greater than the balance after The Arc receives its percentage, this is the balance. If the Enrollment Date is before 10/1/2023 and the TMHP Amount Owed is greater than what is left, this value is $0.
CustomField.label: Amount Retained by Trust
